title: Red Hat Security Advisory: pki-deps:10.6 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for the pki-deps:10.6 module addressing two denial of service vulnerabilities in the jackson-core library. These vulnerabilities involve unbounded StringBuilder growth during malformed token processing (CVE-2026-89425) and excessively long JSON property names (CVE-2026-68498). The advisory also includes bug fixes and enhancements related to the jackson-modules-base installation. The update is rated as having an Important security impact by Red Hat Product Security.
